findings.summary: 判据 3 triage-path test (test/e0c8-timeout.test.ts:375-490) injects triageSpawnRuntime.readResult reimplementing the polling loop rather than driving the production readResult at src/tick-run.ts:1644-1660. The generate-path test (line 492-559) does drive the production readBody discriminatively, and the production readResult has the real isRunExited check, but deleting the production isRunExited branch would not turn the triage test red. Consider having the triage test use the default readResult (no override) the way the generate test does.

判据 2a discriminative test still uses the GT-23-prohibited text-offset comparison form (comparing byte positions of 'HIT WALL CLOCK LIMIT' vs 'HIT ATTEMPT LIMIT' in bin/e0-regression.sh at test/e0c8-timeout.test.ts:121-126). The wall-clock-primary invariant is adequately covered by the profile self-consistency arithmetic check (line 78-95) and the e0c2-termination real-execution tests, so this is non-blocking. Recommend converting 2a's discriminative assertion from text-offset to execution-driven in a future pass.

判据 2b seed-board test (test/e0c8-timeout.test.ts:903-973) now reads workflow.yaml limits.node_timeout for the threshold (addressing the previous final-review blocker), but because spawn and fetch are mocked the elapsed is millisecond-level and the assertion elapsed < nodeTimeoutMs/2 would not turn red if node_timeout were changed back to 30. The node_timeout>=900 discriminative invariant is carried by the 判据 2 workflow.yaml test (line 40-71). No action required for this review cycle.
